Callout.Name: Large Vehicle Failing to Stop
Callout.Message: HGV failing to stop, driver ignoring lights.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle continuing at speed, load insecure.

Script.Line: The HGV has not stopped and the driver is looking at us.
You cannot PIT that. Nobody is PIT-ing that.
We need a stinger, and we need it before the junction.

Lines.Approach: He is not stopping and there is a load on the back of it. Keep your distance.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
